==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace "url," "text," and "archivedate" with the appropriate information.

<code><nowiki>{{D23|url=|text=|author=|date=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://d23.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Title of online item. Note that it should be capitalized the same way that in the <title> of the html document.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|author}} Name(s) of the author(s). Multiple authors must be separated with a "<code>;</code>" between their names. Note that an author is not necessarily an individual and could be an organization. A long list of authors can be reduced using "<code>, et al.</code>" after the first name. Provide wikilinks whenever they are available.
*{{Para|date}} Full date of publication, in [[Wikipedia:ISO 8601|ISO 8601]] <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code> format, for example "<code>|date=2006-02-17</code>".

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{D23|url=creatures-droids-and-aliens-meet-the-fantastical-figures-of-star-wars-galaxys-edge|text=Creatures, Droids, and Aliens: Meet the Fantastical Figures of ''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge|author=Courtney Potter|date=2019-05-29|archivedate=20190716012535}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{D23|url=creatures-droids-and-aliens-meet-the-fantastical-figures-of-star-wars-galaxys-edge|text=Creatures, Droids, and Aliens: Meet the Fantastical Figures of ''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge|author=Courtney Potter|date=2019-05-29|archivedate=20190716012535}}
